Only S15 + E4 remain BLOCKED pending a near-expiry rental Timer seed (QB Timer restarts ~29:5x on relaunch — #28). Open Rental Booking bugs #27–#34: #27 rupee grouping, #28 Timer gate, #29 Skip stuck after Accept, #30 offline Accept opens Assign, #31/#32 stale Accept opens Assign, #33 Address not provided, #34 decline reason not persisted.
